scope: Ordinary full-game NBA player Points and Made Threes only; no promotions, protected bets, team-threes, partial-period, combo or parlay settlement.
performance: Ordinary player-performance totals include overtime. Participation has action regardless of time played; no participation indicates a void.
firstBasket: First Basket includes free throws. First Team Basket is the first scorer for that team; listed nonstarters are void. This profile does not enable a first-basket EV model.
exceptions: NBA postponement beyond the scheduled local date, venue changes and suspended games have specific rules. NBA suspension completion uses a 24-hour rule with exceptions for predetermined markets. The research grader does not adjudicate these exceptions or actual account settlement.
authorityDifference: Project statistics follow the downloaded NBA PDF. Sportsbook settlement may use a subsequent official statistical ruling; a project result is not proof of a sportsbook result. Source revisions must remain traceable.
